margin_distribution.criterion: N*_lib - nov_lib — the excluding stage's criterion, per member
margin_distribution.note: all margins positive — the novelty bar excludes every deep member with room; the closest approach under ANY reading is the counterfactual max nov_lib_vs_frozen72 68.716, still below the frozen bar 82.288

branches.clause: (i) DISTANCE failure — deep programs too similar to each other (the 15 members' pairwise distances concentrated below the novelty bar)
(ii) OUT-COMPETED — the 72 outrank them at a rank-cut
branches.note: the funnel is a two-threshold filter (lib-novelty, splice-clear); there is NO rank-cut stage at which the frozen 72 could outrank the deep members — every novel member is admitted regardless of J-rank (the J-ordered list only sets traversal order); the deep members' J-ranks are recorded as diagnostic

branches.clause: (iii) SPLICE-PRICED — their splices price above N*_splice

consistency_with_exclusion_stage.note: the lib-novelty stage's criterion IS a distance criterion — branch (i) is its mechanism; a splice-clear carrier would map to branch (iii); branch (ii) has no stage to carry (no rank-cut exists)
